name: Gatekeeper (Merc Artillery Bot)
comment: A Gatekeeper's Realm variant (user, research/lmoxide-notes/gatekeeper-variants.md): look bot_artillery_merc 359202. npc_template 2410 is one of the client's 14 "Gatekeeper" names (TDB 51000), paired in order (a guess); level 15 and 7x a regular level-15 enemy's life (boss rank) are guesses. Summon/buff skills (adds) not added yet. Its kit is the client's bot_artillery_merc spells (the user asked for their animations, 2026-10-30): the stomp up close (445569: 4 m around, ×1.0 and a 10 m knockaway, animation and particle 444664) and its two cannons' shells (380345 / 445578, 5–20 m, animation 400918).
